messages:
maria.revn: FYI — Riven Labs reached out asking for a retro rebate on their Q4 pilot. Sales says onboarding delays meant they couldn't fully use capacity. They want a 30% credit on billed usage. attaching invoice snippet soon.

jenna.ae: Confirmed. Pilot period 2025-11-15 -> 2025-12-31 but prod start slipped. They claim under-delivery of onboarding support. Customer asking for $12.4k credit against invoice INV-2026-0012.

sam.finance: Can you paste the invoice line here so we can validate the billed amount and whether any trial/credit covered this?

jenna.ae: `INV-2026-0012 — Riven Labs — billed $12,400 — usage charges $11,900 — support surcharge $500`

sam.finance: Thanks. Quick Q: are they on an enterprise quote or a self-serve plan? Any contractual language about retro credits or service credits?

olivia.legal: We'll need the SOW/quote. Our standard T&Cs don't grant retro credits except for escalated remedial cases. If Finance recommends an exception, Legal needs to approve and draft an addendum.

liam.csm: Customer is mid-market, high-touch. They've flagged churn risk — said they'll pause integration if this isn't sorted.

sam.finance: Draft proposal from Finance standpoint: offer a 15% one-time rebate + one month of Dedicated burst credits (non-monetary). That lowers cash impact but addresses their ask. Thoughts?

jenna.ae: They will push for 30%. If we can go to 20% I can close them on a 12-mo commit. 15% might not be enough to keep momentum.

carter.fp&a: Need ARR/booking impact. 20% of $12.4k is $2,480 cash back. If that secures $60k ARR expansion, looks acceptable. Also call out revenue recognition and GL treatment.

sam.finance: I'll prepare a formal approval request with numbers and precedent notes and tag Legal + CFO. @olivia.legal will need to prepare the addendum wording.

olivia.legal: If Finance signs off, Legal will require the customer to commit to a 12-month term at standard rates in exchange for the rebate. I'll draft a short addendum and route for signatures.

cecil.cfo: Looped in. Need Finance to include: 1) exact credit amount, 2) GL reversal codes, 3) whether we treat as contra-revenue or rebate, and 4) note on precedent. Will review once filed.

sam.finance: Understood. I'll assemble the packet (calcs + invoice + proposed addendum) and queue for CFO approval. ETA: 1 business day.

jenna.ae: Customer expects a firm answer by EOD tomorrow. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray: 

maria.revn: Thanks all — keeping this thread for approvals and decision trace. (reacted :eyes:)
